scope: Preservation of already executed review-only audits; no computation or HTTP request rerun during preservation
origin: Commands copied from the actual tools.exec_command cmd strings visible in this reviewer's current conversation history. A terminal newline was added when storing each ps1. These are not proposed replacement scripts or claims of new execution.
output_provenance: JSON outputs are faithful structured transcriptions of the visible prior tool results, reserialized with normalized whitespace. They are not newly generated process stdout or original byte-for-byte log files.

original_runtime.exact_start_timestamps: Not emitted by the individual audit calls; only sentinel command's Get-Date output is retained

successful_audits.note: Complete original command retained, including history/media, PDF hash and Get-Date reads that followed the clinical sentinels.

failed_attempt.reason: Raw GitHub URL supplied a Git-LFS pointer, parsed into two pseudo-records; assignment to read-only PowerShell $true failed. Shell exit zero was not scientific success. All numerical output from this attempt was discarded.

hash_method: The actual successful scripts hash UTF-8 bytes re-encoded from decoded Invoke-WebRequest Content (handling byte[] explicitly where shown). Mapping and export hashes matched the already pinned input digests. No assertion of a new binary transport-byte receipt is made for this review-only audit.
source_storage: Source responses were held in memory during the original calls, not retained as input files. Precise retrieval URLs, pins and observed hashes are preserved here.
